description: The chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with different language-family categories in the referenced study, shown as a horizontal bar chart. The category axis is vertical, listing (top to bottom) IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque; the ordering appears to follow decreasing bar length from top to bottom. The value axis is horizontal and labeled “# tasks,” using a linear scale with tick marks at regular intervals of 10, spanning approximately 0 to 80. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar: IE-Slavic (blue-gray) extends to about 79 tasks, IE-Romance (dark blue) to about 47, IE-Germanic (green-gray) to about 44, Uralic (dark green) to about 20, IE-Baltic (muted mauve) to about 17, IE-other (dark red) to about 15, IE-Indic (brown-gray) to about 10, Semitic (brown) to about 8, Turkic (dark gray) to about 4, and Basque (purple-gray) to about 3. There is no legend, stacking, or grouping indicated, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond their distinct fill colors.
